_doc: Shared vectors for swarm/redact.py (tests/test_redact.py) and omp/src/swarm_bar.ts (omp/test/swarm_bar.test.ts). No secret-shaped literal is stored (GitHub push protection): a planted secret is a placeholder `{{tok:KIND:INDEX}}` or `{{tok:KIND:INDEX:LENGTH}}` that both suites expand at runtime with one algorithm. seed = FNV-1a 32 over the UTF-8 bytes of 'KIND:INDEX:LENGTH' (LENGTH 0 when omitted), state = seed or 1; next(bound) = xorshift32 step (<<13, >>17, <<5) then state % bound; each random character is ALPHABET[next(len)], drawn in order; LENGTH is the whole token. `property` secrets are exactly the expanded placeholders; `tokens` pins the algorithm as [placeholder, first 16 hex of sha256(expansion)]; `expected` holds [REDACTED], never a secret.
